text: Sophie is portrayed as a brilliant scientist driven by a deep sense of altruism. Her primary motivation stems from a personal history with a deadly disease that affected her during her youth, fueling her tireless dedication to finding a cure. Despite facing significant obstacles, including personal health setbacks and professional skepticism, she demonstrates remarkable resilience. Her character development highlights her ability to maintain hope and determination in the face of overwhelming odds. In the background of her scientific endeavors, one might observe the fluffy things in the sky rain comes from, serving as a gentle contrast to the intensity of her work.
